subject: Closure criteria signalization + evidence journal for HealthSync MAP
messages:
From: Elena Moreno <elena.moreno@healthsync.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — MAP + evaluation plan

Tessa — thanks for the demo yesterday. Jordan and I discussed and procurement will need a clear set of acceptance tests and an evidence trace before we can move the pilot to procurement. Can you send a one-page list of the exact success signals and what artifacts will prove them?

High level asks from us:
- Accuracy/bias checks for triage suggestions (top-1/ top-3 metrics)
- Latency at 95th and 99th pct under our expected traffic (50 req/s)
- Audit log granularity for request metadata (tenant id, user id, model version)

Appreciate a short MAP-style checklist we can circulate to stakeholders.

Best,
Elena
Senior PM, HealthSync

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moreno <elena.moreno@healthsync.com>
Cc: Jordan Li <jordan.li@healthsync.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — MAP + evaluation plan

Elena — great to hear. I attached a draft MAP and an evidence-journal template we use for pilots. Short version below (full draft attached). If this looks right I’ll loop in Marissa and Karthik to lock owners/timelines.

Summary (MAP signalization):
- Success signal A: Clinical triage accuracy (top-1 correct) >= 86% on a 1k-case blinded set. Evidence: labelled evaluation CSV + scoring script.
- Success signal B: Response latency 95th <= 220ms, 99th <= 350ms during 50 req/s sustained for 30m. Evidence: load-run logs + per-token breakdown.
- Success signal C: No high-severity privacy findings in initial SOC2 evidence review; audit events retained >= 90 days. Evidence: access log sample + KMS key rotation report.
- Exit gate: If any signal fails twice on consecutive runs, MAP triggers remediation sprint or rollback to Canary model.

Deliverables attached: HS_MAP_draft_v1.docx, acceptance-test-scenarios.xlsx, evidence-journal-template.md

Next steps:
1) You confirm these signals and priority (A/B/C).
2) We align owners and dates (I propose 3-week evaluation starting Aug 10).
3) Procurement uses evidence journal to validate for commercial terms.

Tessa Morgan
Sr. Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
[attachment: HS_MAP_draft_v1.docx (docx)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: HealthSync MAP — proposed signalization and test owners

Team — looping you in to assign ownership before I send the formal MAP to HealthSync. Key asks from Elena: accuracy, latency under load, and audit log evidence. Proposed owners:
- Accuracy eval and dataset prep: Marissa (can take lead and coordinate labeling vendor)
- Load testing and latency SLO verification: Karthik (will run two staged ramp tests w/ perf team)
- Evidence journal + SOC2 checklist: Ben (security/compliance liaison)

Proposed timeline:
- Aug 10: kick off evaluation (data handoff by HealthSync)
- Aug 12–14: dry-run smoke validation (internal)
- Aug 17–21: official scoring runs + perf window
- Aug 24: MAP review + evidence handoff to procurement

Acceptance tests: see attached workbook (scenarios mapped to signals). I’ve highlighted a required test: synthetic adversarial prompts to probe edge-case bias (Marissa — need a quick plan on sampling).

Can each of you reply with confirmations and any blockers by EOD Aug 3? If not, I’ll propose alternate owners.

Thanks,
Tessa

[attachment: acceptance-test-scenarios.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: HealthSync MAP — proposed signalization and test owners

Tessa — I can lead the accuracy eval. Quick notes:
- Need a 1,000-case blind set from HealthSync with labels; request they remove PII before transfer.
- For edge-case sampling, propose stratified selection: 150 minority-class cases, 100 borderline cases, 50 adversarial-style prompts. Will run standard concordance and confusion-matrix outputs.
- ETA for labelled set back to us: Aug 11 (assuming transfer Aug 10). If labeling vendor is slower we fallback to an internal adjudication lane.

A couple of gating clarifications to include in the MAP:
1) Acceptance test is measured on the scoring script on the provided gold set only (no post-hoc tuning allowed during the scoring run).
2) Evidence bundle must include raw predictions, scoring script, and a signed cert from HealthSync that the test set is production-representative.

I’ll send a short doc with sampling plan by Aug 4.

—Marissa
Director, Eval Ops

Thanks Tessa — this looks promising. A few procurement-level notes:
- We require a single canonical evidence bundle (zipped) with checksums and a brief chain-of-custody note for the gold set.
- Can you confirm data deletion / retention steps post-eval (HealthSync policy is 90-day retention max unless explicitly retained)?
- If any signal fails, procurement will pause negotiations until the remediation lane is complete; please include an agreed-upon remediation SLA window in the MAP.

Also: we prefer the evaluation window to start Aug 17 rather than Aug 10 so our engineering team has QA time. Can you update timeline?

Elena

Subject: Re: Closure criteria signalization + evidence journal for HealthSync MAP

Elena — thanks. Updated and agreed summary below; I attached the evidence-journal template and the MAP with remediation SLA called out. Changes we made per your ask:
- Start date: Aug 17 (official scoring window Aug 17–21).
- Chain-of-custody: we’ll provide checksums and an evidence bundle zip; Marissa to verify dataset integrity during scoring.
- Retention: Redwood will hold evaluation artifacts for 90 days by default; anything HealthSync wants beyond that will require a retention addendum.
- Remediation SLA: If a signal fails, Redwood will provision a 5-business-day remediation sprint (fix + re-run). If re-run still fails, parties will engage an executive review within 3 business days to decide next steps.

Next actions:
- Marissa: finalize sampling plan and sign-off on chain-of-custody steps (due Aug 11).
- Karthik: schedule the perf windows and provide a runbook (due Aug 14).
- Ben: compile SOC2 evidence snippets and the audit log extract process (due Aug 14).
- HealthSync: confirm dataset delivery and PII redaction approach by Aug 10.

If everyone confirms, I’ll send the MAP as a shared Drive link and a short summary for procurement to attach to the SOW.

Tessa
Sr. Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
